company.name: Virtru
company.shortDescription: Virtru provides data encryption for email and file sharing, enabling users to easily control access to their sensitive data.
company.description: Virtru offers end‑to‑end encryption and access control for emails, file sharing, and SaaS workflows. It secures messages and attachments within Gmail and Outlook via browser plugins, enabling features like revocation, expiration, watermarking, and downloadable restrictions. The platform extends encryption to files shared via Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, and secure SaaS apps, while enabling hosted or on-premises key management through its Private Keystore. With attribute‑based access controls, persistent policy enforcement, and audit visibility, Virtru allows organizations to maintain sovereignty over shared data without disrupting existing workflows.
company.headquarters: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

aiResearchSummary.text: Virtru is focused on developing methods and systems for securing data access and distribution. Their research includes securing containerized applications by intercepting IP requests, distributing encrypted cryptographic data through a key service, and restricting data access based on process and machine properties. These efforts align with their mission to protect sensitive data in email, files, and SaaS applications, ensuring secure data flow in and out of businesses.
